data.title: Bitcoin Is Up 33% in 90 Days but Still Down 30% From Last Year: Who’s Still Facing Losses?
data.description: Bitcoin has staged an impressive quarterly comeback, but millions of buyers are still watching their portfolios bleed red. Whether you break even depends entirely on one number: the price you paid.
